Definition: to shroud, i.e. clothe (whether transitive or reflex.); hence (from the idea of darkness) to languish
BiblicalUsage: 1) to turn aside; 1a) (Qal) to turn aside, turn (in order to cover); 2) to envelop oneself; 2a) (Qal) to envelop oneself, cover; 3) to be feeble, be faint, grow weak; 3a) (Qal) to be feeble, be faint; 3b) (Niphal) to faint; 3c) (Hiphil) to show feebleness; 3d) (Hithpael) to faint, faint away
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
